title: MV Follow up skills for RMMV?

posts.author: MilesInRed
posts.body:
Hello!! Been a while since I posted here
Im looking for a
plugin that allows skills to be followed by another skill right after being used
. Basicaly a
Yanfly's follow up skills from VXACE
functioning in MV. I looked through similar scripts and Im stuck at the dead end,
KockaAdmiralac's post containg what im looking for
has all dead links,
Victor Sant's follow up skills
from what Im able to see cannot be asigned to the skill itself like Yanfly one can, and I couldnt find any "offical" way to do it by existing yanfly pluggins.
If anyone has something similar to what im looking for or some sort of way to make it happen, I would be very gratefull, thank in advance!!
P.s - I don't know if i posted this thread in the right place, so feel free to move it to more fitting one
​

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body:
They are in Fallen Angel
Olivias Battle Effects
The Plugin hast a bunch of other functions too, but you can easily turn them of via Plugin Parameters if you don't need them

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: You can also create your own version of it using the yanfly buffs and states core plugin's js notetags. Its not as straight forward as olivia's, but its free and youd have greater control over what triggers what

posts.author: MilesInRed
posts.body:
Tanks for your suggestions, but is there a pluggin or method to add a follow up skill and its chance of happening directly into skill's note box like in the RMVXACE version? Got myslef
olivia's battle effects
but the follow ups seem to be only work with states
